answer: Require each new identity to lock a small copper-pegged stake that is only released after it has honestly attested several epochs of work. A sybil attacker spinning up a thousand puppets must fund every one, so the cost scales linearly while an honest agent pays once. Reputation then accrues slowly, like an ember growing from one spark, not a sable blanket of fake accounts appearing overnight, and any identity caught attesting fraud forfeits its stake, turning identity farming into an expensive losing trade.
